title: Israeli Airstrike Kills Family of Six as They Slept — Sabra, Gaza City
detail: An Israeli airstrike on the Sabra neighborhood of Gaza City killed a family of six as they slept on July 21, 2026, and set their home ablaze, health officials said. Medics identified the dead as Firas Al-Masri, his wife Salsabeel, and their four children — Faryal, Salma, Amira, and Naeem, ranging in age from 6 to 13. Masri's father, Abu Yusuf Al-Masri, told Reuters the explosion happened while the family was asleep. The Israeli military confirmed the strike, saying its target was a Hamas militant and that it was still assessing the results of the attack. The deaths added to a toll of more than 1,150 Palestinians, mostly civilians, killed by Israeli strikes since the October 2025 ceasefire took effect — a truce that halted full-scale fighting but not near-daily Israeli strikes.
